_comment_version_1_85_0: 1.84.0 -> 1.85.0: new LoadQuietGate (load_silence.dart, exported), armed in BaseSdkDependencies.register. Until the person touches the screen or presses a key, AppHelpers.showCheckTopSnackBar (and with it ErrorPresenter.show/showTechnical and auth_sdk AuthErrorPresenter) and AppHelpers.showNoConnectionSnackBar show nothing and log to debug output; presenter telemetry still goes out. A return to the app whose last touch is older than LoadQuietGate.staleAfter (2 minutes) starts quiet again. Unarmed hosts and tests are unchanged. Ray: being offline or logged out must never be shown as an error (minilauncher 1.2.16 still showed a server error on splash/login while signed out).

_comment_version_1_74_0: 1.73.0 -> 1.74.0: relative-time fixture tokens for DemoFixtures (Ray, 2026-09-25). $now_iso, $now_ms and the new $today (UTC yyyy-MM-dd) accept one signed offset <+|-><n><m|h|d|w>, e.g. $now_iso-30d, $now_ms+2h, $today-7d, so dated demo fixtures (billing history, term reports, announcements, entitlements) stay current instead of freezing. Strings that do not match exactly are left unchanged. DemoFixtures.resolveTimeToken is public for tests.
_comment_version_1_73_0: 1.72.3 -> 1.73.0: one demo seam in the HTTP layer (Ray, 2026-09-25: "Demo skips the real code"). New DemoGatewayInterceptor, first on every HttpService Dio client, answers POST /api/v1/method/rokct.platform.api from <cmd>.json fixture files while DemoSession.demoActive - read per request, never cached - so a demo session runs the REAL repository and only the network hop is replaced. SDKs register fixture asset directories with DemoFixtures.registerAssetDirectory. A known cmd resolves with its fixture (the value inside Frappe's message envelope); an unknown cmd in demo fails with DemoFixtureMissing naming the cmd, never a silent pass and never the network. Fixtures may use $now_iso / $now_ms tokens and a $demo_select object (by payload.<field> or role). Outside a demo session it is a pass-through; non-gateway paths pass through too, so SDKs still routing demo through their own Demo repositories are unaffected. Demo login and demo data are unchanged.
_comment_version_1_72_2: 1.72.1 -> 1.72.2: GenericProfilePage fixes from Ray's 2026-09-23 student-app notes. The plan flip card keeps the FRONT's height when flipped (the back fills that box and scrolls inside it). Gate answers are remembered across mounts on ProfileSectionRegistry (lastGateResults / lastHeaderSlotGateResults, cleared by reset()), so a re-mounted profile starts from the last answer and the menu does not shift; gates are still re-asked on every mount. The scroll padding reserves room for the floating nav pill so the footer's app-name row is not hidden.
_comment_version_1_72_0: 1.71.0 -> 1.72.0: release builds silence debugPrint (Ray, 2026-09-24: silence it in production, do not remove the calls). templates/main.dart replaces debugPrint with a no-op under kReleaseMode right after ensureInitialized, before boot hooks and runApp, so every shell composed from base_sdk inherits it. The uncaught-error handlers keep a reference to the original printer (crashLog), so crash records still reach logcat / the Windows console.
_comment_version_1_71_0: 1.69.0 -> 1.71.0 (1.70.0 is the TrKeys identity change in its own PR): the Android launcher label stops coming from a CUSTOMER_APP_NAME dart-define (Ray, 2026-09-23). The resValue line is gone from templates/android/app/build.gradle; the label is res/values/strings.xml's app_name, which the composer now sets from the HOME SDK's manifest "app_name" (The-Rokct-Protocol update_android_app_name). One define was one name for every app type, and the app type already decides the home SDK. A home SDK that declares no app_name keeps the neutral default 'Juvo' in strings.xml.
_comment_version_1_70_0: 1.69.0 -> 1.70.0: the app's own name and motto stop being translation keys (Ray, 2026-09-23). TrKeys.appName ('juvo') and TrKeys.appMotto ('motto') are removed, with the two bundled Afrikaans rows that served them ('juvo': 'Juvo', 'motto': 'Een klik weg.'). They are app identity, owned by AppConstants.appTitle and AppConstants.appMotto and re-pointed per app through a home SDK's constants.overrides. Declared as TrKeys, every consumer asked the translation map instead, so a compose-time override was invisible: with no served 'motto' row the onboarding welcome card showed the humanised key, or the old JUVO Afrikaans motto, instead of the app's own. The only code consumer was onboarding_sdk's intro page, which now reads AppConstants.appMotto (onboarding_sdk 1.2.2) - that change must merge FIRST, or onboarding stops compiling against this base. The composer now refuses appName/appTitle/appMotto as an SDK tr_key (The-Rokct-Protocol), so the path cannot come back. AppConstants and its override mechanism are untouched.
_comment_version_1_69_0: 1.68.0 -> 1.69.0: the host offers one more optional Kotlin bridge, AppChangesBridge, so a launcher shell can be told when the device's installed apps change (Ray, 2026-09-21: "how do other launchers remember when app has installed and put icon in their screen?"). The bridge itself is launch_sdk's and ships in ITS templates; base_sdk only names it in MainActivity's OPTIONAL_BRIDGES and keeps it from being stripped, exactly as DefaultHomeBridge is handled. Registration stays reflective, so a compose without launch_sdk has no such class and simply registers nothing - no build break, no runtime throw. No Dart change.
_comment_app_assets: app_assets registers these files in the host app's pubspec 'sdk-app-assets' block so they are bundled into the build. Only assets referenced by SDK code are kept here; legacy upstream-era driver/manager assets were removed (they live in paas_driver/paas_manager develop, and custodianship copies moved to delivery_sdk/merchants_sdk).

database._comment: No 'tables' key on purpose. base_sdk's own tables (KeyValueTable, OutboxTable, IdMappingsTable) are declared directly in the @DriftDatabase annotation in lib/src/database/app_database.dart, and the installer COPIES every table source named here into base_sdk's own package to import relatively - so listing them would compile two copies of each class. Only the migration is declared.
database._comment_migration: THE MIGRATION VERSION NUMBER IS SHARED WITH EVERY OTHER SDK IN THE APP, AND IS NOT THIS SDK'S TO COUNT ALONE. sdk_installer_base.py update_database_registration() sets the composed AppDatabase's schemaVersion to the MAXIMUM version any composed manifest declares, while each SDK writes its own `if (from < N)` guard into the one shared onUpgrade - one namespace, no allocator. Drift calls onUpgrade only when schemaVersion is GREATER than the stored user_version, so a number at or below the running maximum runs nothing at all on a device that is already there, and the column this step adds would simply never appear (productivity_sdk lost its notes table to exactly this, and this manifest's number is chosen the way that manifest's comment says to). Two further traps are specific to base: the composer SUBSTITUTES the schemaVersion getter in app_database.dart, so a base-owned number written only in Dart is erased at compose time; and max_version is only raised inside the installer's `if version and step` branch, so a version declared without a step raises nothing. Hence both, declared here. VERSIONS READ ACROSS THE FLEET BEFORE CLAIMING 19 (every manifest.json outside a .rokct/cache in every repo reachable from this workspace, read at their current main): radio_sdk 18 (agent/radio/dart), productivity_sdk 17 (productivity/productivity/dart), auth_sdk 16 (Users/auth/dart), agent_sdk 15 (agent/agent/dart), replay_sdk 15 (agent/replay/dart), subscriptions_sdk 15 (agent/subscriptions/dart), polaris_sdk 13 (corporate/polaris/dart), fav_sdk 12 (agent/fav/dart); no other manifest declares a database.migration at all - base_sdk, launch_sdk, comms_sdk and telemetry_sdk in this repo included, until now. 19 is above all of them. NOTE for whoever reads this next: radio_sdk's 17 and productivity_sdk's 17 are a LIVE COLLISION on that number (radio's own comment still records productivity at 14), which is not this PR's to fix but is the same defect all of this text is about. The step is idempotent - ensureOwnerScopeColumns() checks for the column before touching anything - and beforeOpen in app_database.dart calls it on every open as a floor, so a device that somehow skips this step still gets the column rather than throwing on its first read.

_comment_app_type: The tenant remote-config boot absorbed from the retired host lib/utils/app_initializer.dart files (manager migration M5, driver M4). Flavor-gated because the fetch is per-app ('app_type=Manager' / 'app_type=Driver'); other flavors declare their own entry with their own app_type string when they flip to fully generated shells. base_sdk has no lib/src/manager|driver role folders - declaring the personas only carries these hooks (role-stripping is a no-op for base).
